strategy.summary: The todo app (static public/app.js served by server.js, state held in memory in the page) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed and clear completed todos. The tests drive the real app in Chromium with Playwright and prove each ticket criterion through user-visible state: strike-through, the "items left" count, the listed items, aria-pressed on the filter buttons, and whether "Clear completed" is shown.
inScope: Toggling completion via the checkbox (strike-through + items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real first-party server (node server.js) runs via the existing playwright.config.js webServer; nothing is faked. There's no backend API or access control.
Todo state lives in page memory, so each test gets fresh state from its own page and creates its own todos through the UI.
"Struck through" is checked as the computed text-decoration-line: line-through on the todo's title, not the CSS class.
Each todo's checkbox has its title as accessible name (label wraps checkbox and text).

risks.description: Items-left count not updated or wrong after toggling
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert the exact count text before and after

risks.description: Filters show wrong set of todos, or pressed state not updated
risks.mitigation: TC3–TC5 assert the exact list contents and aria-pressed of every filter button

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or is shown with nothing completed
risks.mitigation: TC6 asserts hidden states, TC7 asserts only active todos remain

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed (struck through) and lowers the items-left count by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All shows every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and lowers the items left count
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked and its title has line-through; 'Walk dog' is not struck; count reads '1 item left' (was '2 items left')

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the count
steps: Tick 'Buy milk' and see '1 item left'
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line none, count '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that aren't completed and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly the two uncompleted todos; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly the completed todo; Completed pressed, others not
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again after another filter and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List shows all three todos in order; All pressed, others not
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add a todo: Clear completed hidden
testCases.expected: Hidden before ticking, visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List shows only the uncompleted todo; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Removes all completed, not just one, and nothing else

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright starts node server.js on port 4173 via the existing webServer config; BASE_URL http://localhost:4173. Chromium must be installed.
